title: Practice 15: Irregular comparatives: лучше, больше, старше

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Marina is older than Catherine.
exercises.why: **старший → старше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Beer is cheaper than water in the Czech Republic.
exercises.why: **дешёвый → дешевле** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: They caught up with us later.
exercises.why: **поздний → позже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: It's cheaper to rent.
exercises.why: **дешёвый → Дешевле** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: ___ (поздний) читатели узнают, что Дэн — киборг, отказавшийся подчиняться приказам хозяина.
exercises.prompt: Readers later come to know that Den is a cyborg that has refused to obey its master's orders.
exercises.why: **поздний → Позже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: The lie is easier to believe.
exercises.why: **лёгкий → легче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: There is an extra charge for mailing packages by express.
exercises.why: **дорогой → дороже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Which emoji do you use the most often?
exercises.why: **частый → чаще** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Hold your horses, Tom.
exercises.why: **лёгкий → Полегче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: I can't walk any further.
exercises.why: **далёкий → дальше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Mega Bloks are less expensive than legos.
exercises.why: **дешёвый → дешевле** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: It's easier to make plans than to carry them out.
exercises.why: **лёгкий → Легче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Forgive your neighbor often, yourself never.
exercises.why: **частый → чаще** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: You need to walk more often.
exercises.why: **частый → чаще** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Nonstop flights are almost always more expensive.
exercises.why: **дорогой → дороже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Mary moved closer to him.
exercises.why: **близкий → ближе** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: That's child's play.
exercises.why: **простой → проще** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Get to the point.
exercises.why: **близкий → ближе** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Deceiving the inexperienced youths was a walk in the park.
exercises.why: **простой → проще** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Beef is more expensive than chicken.
exercises.why: **дорогой → дороже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.
